Affidavit of service filed by the petitioner is taken on
 record.

The petitioner is aggrieved by the amount of  compensation received by him for acquisition of his land  by the State-respondents and submitted an application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 1956") before the learned Arbitrator on April 03, 2023.
The said application is yet to be considered.
The petitioner prays for a direction upon the learned Arbitrator to consider the application at the earliest.
It is submitted on behalf of the respondents that the learned Arbitrator, being the 6th respondent herein, be directed to consider and dispose of the application in accordance with law.

In view of the above, the writ petition is disposed of directing the 6th respondent to consider and dispose of the said application submitted by the petitioner on 3rd April, 2023 within a period of two months from the date of communication of this order, after giving reasonable opportunity of Prabin Kumar Agarwal vs Union Of India & Ors on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62285544/
1 hearing to all the interested persons including the petitioner, in accordance with law.
